verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents a first-party CLI at docs.firecrawl.dev/sdks/cli. It installs with one command, authenticates through the browser, and adds skills to detected coding agents, which directly serves AI-native workflows. missing for 10: a documented command reference showing which operations the CLI supports (scrape/crawl/search/etc.), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: One command installs the Firecrawl CLI, authenticates in your browser, and adds skills to every detected coding agent.
